description:
A charming detached four-bedroom, two-bathroom bungalow set on approximately 0.64 acres, enjoying beautiful maintained gardens and a lovely patio area. The property offers generous outdoor space, privacy and excellent potential for family living. Ideally located within 1km of the local primary school, making it particularly appealing to families.

The accommodation briefly comprises of a welcoming entrance hallway with tiled flooring, stira to the attic. A lovely cosy sitting room with solid fuel fireplace and two window front aspect. A modern fully fitted kitchen/dining room has a dual aspect and patio doors to the side. Four bedrooms, two with built in wardrobes, the master contains a walk-in wardrobe and ensuite. The main family bathroom is part tiled and contains a three-piece suite.

The exterior of this home is well maintained with the gardens mainly in lawn, having a selection of fruit trees and shrubberies, patio area to the side off the dining area, tarmac driveway offering ample car parking space.

Superbly located within 1 km to Killeen primary school, 6km to Granard town for two post-primary schools, crèches and a host of amenities both social and essential, local employers include Pat the Baker, Supervalu, a hardware, credit union, multiple restaurants, hotel and pubs. Granard Area Action Group: A local community development and employment organization involved in local schemes. The Bank (Coworking Space) is located on Market Street. Sporting facilities include Higginstown Sports Complex & Court for tennis and basketball, Granard Greenway, GAA Club, Pitch & Putt, Archery to name a few. Public transport in Granard is serviced by the TFI Local Link Route 865: Operates daily service connecting Lough Gowna, Aughnacliffe, Granard, Ballinalee, Enybegs, and Longford Station/Centre.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
